name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted vanity installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted vanity installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A freestanding vanity rests directly on the floor and is secured to the wall for stability, often offering more storage capacity and a traditional look. A wall-mounted (or floating) vanity is attached directly to the wall, leaving the floor space beneath clear, which can create a more open and modern aesthetic. Wall-mounted installations often require careful structural assessment and precise mounting to ensure safety and stability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding vanities sit on the floor, offering more storage, while wall-mounted vanities attach to the wall for a modern look.
